citations.description: Ticket comment 3 (GATE STATUS at handoff): 'The FULL default selection did NOT complete. Not a failure: this host is saturated by other agents (load average peaked at 66 with three other full suites running) and the run advanced about 1% per 10 minutes. Two earlier attempts were killed by the harness at ~50 min with exit 144 - a kill, not a test result. The third is running DETACHED (nohup, pid 57403) and was at 26% at handoff, writing to /tmp/final_run2.txt; tail that file for the verdict.'

findings.criterion: make lint and make typecheck pass by exit code; the default selection is green.
findings.detail: The ticket comment explicitly states 'The FULL default selection did NOT complete' — the run was killed by the harness (exit 144, a SIGKILL) at ~26% progress, not by test failures. A targeted regression over the affected set (168 passed, 6 skipped, exit 0) was completed, and make lint exit 0 / make typecheck exit 0 are attested, but the full default-selection green exit code is not confirmed. The AC requires the default selection to be green, and that has not been established.
findings.remediation: Complete a full default-selection run (`pytest -m 'not integration and not external' -n 6 --dist worksteal`) to exit 0 and record the result (pass count, exit code, timestamp) as a ticket comment before closing.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
